inspos.title: Steve Jobs' 2005 Stanford Commencement Address
inspos.description: Drawing from some of the most pivotal points in his life, Steve Jobs, chief executive officer and co-founder of Apple Computer and of Pixar Animation Studios, urged graduates to pursue their dreams and see the opportunities in life's setbacks.
inspos.note: Three stories, one lesson each. Steal the structure for a talking-head video.

inspos.title: Me at the zoo
inspos.description: The first video ever uploaded to YouTube. One take, nineteen seconds, in front of the elephants.
inspos.note: Proof that a simple idea, shot plainly, can still travel.
